statement: Let w be a continuity point of the extracted profile, let δk logL nk → w, and put a∗ = A(w). The free rectangular limits are those in Lemma 5.2; if a∗ > 0, their fractional means have the conclusion of Lemma 5.3, and their fixed primary pinned geometries have the Gaussian Laplace and moment limits of Lemma 5.4. In particular, on a square interior surrounded by a fixed positive-width zero rim, the covariance of bounded piecewise continuous density smears converges to a∗(−∆D)−1, with Dirichlet boundary on that square. On the zero-winding height torus of side nk, every smooth periodic shift g satisfies Var(h, Atorgk) −→ a∗ Z T2 |∇g|2 . (5.31) Thus the area-weighted first cosine observation in (3.29) has limiting variance a∗g, where g = 1/(8π2).
